design.fills: BUY fills strictly before end_epoch in contested (<=10bps) markets
design.labels: universe winner overridden by on-chain ConditionResolution payouts where backfilled
design.timing_weights: stake = $ spent; potential payout = shares; realized payout = winning shares
design.censoring: trade caches reach ~300s before close; earlier entries invisible
design.selection_caveat: core wallets were SELECTED for extreme edge and profiled on the same data — raw win rates are winner's-curse inflated; market_win_rate_shrunk pulls toward no-edge with 20 pseudo-bets; rows with small_sample_caveat are anecdotes, not estimates
